records.title: Authentication and authorization remain separate
records.statement: Application policy independently constrains authenticated identities and privileged operations.

records.title: Changes cross automated engineering validation
records.statement: The controlled pipeline checks source, tests, contracts, migrations, dependencies, and the Worker build.

records.title: Production deployments are release-bound
records.statement: Reviewed changes are released through annotated semantic tags and exact-tag deployment verification.

records.title: Diagnostics and audit evidence are separated
records.statement: Public diagnostics are bounded and redacted while meaningful control actions use a distinct audit stream.

records.title: Secret values remain environment-owned
records.statement: Public source contains configuration names and placeholders but excludes production credential values.

records.title: Availability is observable and can fail safely
records.statement: Health, deployment identity, and intentional offline behavior expose current state without weakening protected boundaries.

records.title: The public MCP capability is read-only and bounded
records.statement: Approved reads, invalid scopes, unknown methods, and prohibited writes cross explicit validation and authorization behavior.
